Room.title: Room
Room.description: A live collaborative whiteboard room session with host and global lock controls.

hostId.description: Persistent client identifier of the room host.

allGuestsLocked.description: Whether all guests are globally locked into view-only mode.

pageCols.description: Horizontal page multiplier in 100% VW increments.

pageRows.description: Vertical page multiplier in 100% VH increments.

pingId.description: ID of the latest shift-click pointer ping.

pingX.description: X coordinate of the latest pointer ping.

pingY.description: Y coordinate of the latest pointer ping.

pingColor.description: Color of the latest pointer ping.

clearedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of the last full board clear.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of the last room metadata update.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: A participant connected to a live whiteboard room with real-time cursor and write permission state.

name.description: Display name shown in participant list and live cursor.

color.description: Cursor and avatar badge hex color.

isHost.description: True if this participant is the host of the room.

canWrite.description: True if the host has granted write access to this participant.

kicked.description: True if the host has removed this participant from the session.

cursorX.description: Current X position of the participant cursor on the page.

cursorY.description: Current Y position of the participant cursor on the page.

cursorActive.description: Whether the participant cursor is currently active on the board.

lastSeen.description: Epoch timestamp of the participant's latest activity.

BoardElement.title: BoardElement
BoardElement.description: An individual drawing stroke, shape, text annotation, or media item on a hosted whiteboard.

payload.description: Serialized element geometry and style attributes.

updatedBy.description: Participant userId who created or last modified the element.

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp of the element mutation.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Stores live whiteboard room metadata, page expansion bounds, and global guest lock state.

/rooms/{roomCode}/participants/{particip.description: Stores active participants, their view/write permissions, kick status, and live cursor coordinates.

/rooms/{roomCode}/elements/{elementId}.description: Stores individual strokes, shapes, text boxes, and images/PDF pages for the room.
